_status: NEW 2026-08-13 (BRICS/G.2). Brazil's fourth slice and the second BRICS-branch round, built directly on br-ipca-fpe.json's own open leads and on br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json's Union-level RREO/RGF pair. Nine nodes in four clusters. (1) NATIONAL ACCOUNTS — the scope br-ipca-fpe.json's own _status deliberately left open ("national accounts (Sistema de Contas Nacionais) remains out of scope for a future session"): br-scn (Sistema de Contas Nacionais: Brasil, IBGE, anual) and br-cnt (Contas Nacionais Trimestrais, IBGE, trimestral), both wired to the existing international node sna-2008 (international-standards.json) and to each other. (2) FISCAL CONSOLIDATION — br-finbra (Finanças do Brasil / FINBRA on SICONFI, Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional) and br-mdf (Manual de Demonstrativos Fiscais, STN), which together supply the missing upstream and downstream of br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json's br-rreo and br-rgf: the MDF is the method those two reports are written to, and FINBRA is the national database they are aggregated into. (3) INPC's statutory downstream, which br-ipca-fpe.json's own _dropped block recorded as NOT FOUND and this round closes with two independent statutes: br-lei-8213 (art. 41-A, RGPS benefit readjustment) and br-lei-14663 (the permanent minimum-wage valorisation policy), plus the two annual instruments that execute them, br-portaria-reajuste-inss and br-decreto-salario-minimo. (4) br-pnad-continua (PNAD Contínua, IBGE) — minted on its own merits as a titled, recurrent IBGE release, and deliberately carrying NO edge to br-fpe-dn-tcu: the hoped-for rdpc edge was rejected on three independent grounds including a failed numeric corroboration, recorded in full in _dropped. Four entries in br-ipca-fpe.json's own _dropped block were rewritten in place by this round rather than deleted (one to `resolved`, three hardened or answered in the negative).
_note: VERIFICATION TIERS. TIER A (genuine government bytes, downloaded with plain `curl` and parsed locally with `pdftotext -layout` or tag-stripping, no rendering proxy anywhere in the chain): every planalto.gov.br statute and decree below (Lei 8.213/1991, Lei 14.663/2023, Decreto 12.797/2025, LC 62/1989, LC 101/2000), the in.gov.br DOU text of Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF nº 13/2026, the STN FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha PDF on siconfi.tesouro.gov.br, both IBGE contas-nacionais product pages, the IBGE library catalogue record and release PDF for PNAD Contínua's "Rendimento de todas as fontes: 2023", and both Banco Central resolution PDFs (Res. 2.615/1999 and the Res. 4.367/2014 that revokes it). TIER B (r.jina.ai rendering proxy, used only where the direct fetch failed and recorded as such): the PNAD Contínua product page and the TCU FPE-2025 Decisão Normativa PDF. ACCESS CAVEATS, each verified by raw curl rather than assumed. (i) www.planalto.gov.br returns `curl: (52) Empty reply from server` to a header-less request and genuine HTTP 200 with full bytes once a normal browser User-Agent is supplied — every Planalto extraction here is real government bytes obtained with a UA header, stated rather than hidden. (ii) portal.tcu.gov.br served HTTP 200 and ~50KB that were NOT the PDF but a JS bot-challenge page (`<!DOCTYPE html> ... window["bobcmn"]`) — exactly the failure mode where a 200 is not the document, which is why the TCU re-read is Tier B and not Tier A; this is a different failure from br-ipca-fpe.json's observed TLS reset on the same host, so the block shape is not stable between sessions. (iii) www.ibge.gov.br is path-inconsistent: /estatisticas/economicas/contas-nacionais/... served genuine 200s, while /estatisticas/sociais/trabalho/17270-pnad-continua.html returned a genuine 403 with a ~5.8KB WAF body, twice. (iv) www.gov.br/tesouronacional/.../siconfi returns a genuine HTTP 401 whose body reads "Conteúdo Restrito É necessário autenticar para visualizar essa página" — genuinely access-restricted rather than blocked; the public route is siconfi.tesouro.gov.br. (v) ALL *.stf.jus.br hosts, including bare domain roots, produced `000` with zero bytes, and r.jina.ai reached STF only to receive a genuine 403 — STF was wholly unreachable this round (see _dropped, and the rewritten ADI 875 entry in br-ipca-fpe.json). (vi) The Ministry's own PDF of Portaria 13/2026 is a scanned raster (pdftotext yields 4 bytes; pdfimages confirms every page is a JPEG) with no `por` tesseract pack available — the in.gov.br DOU HTML was the working route. NODE WITHOUT EDGES: br-pnad-continua is minted deliberately isolated. That is the finding, not an omission — see the first _dropped entry. EDGES NOT RE-MINTED: STN's Cartilha also states RREO's and RGF's own LRF mandates ("conforme definido no art. 53 da LRF", "conforme definido no art. 55 da LRF"), but br-rreo -> br-lc-101-2000 and br-rgf -> br-lc-101-2000 already exist in br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json, sourced from the statute itself, so they are left alone rather than duplicated from a weaker source.

reports.title: Pesquisa Nacional por Amostra de Domicílios Contínua (PNAD Contínua)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: IBGE's continuous household sample survey, the country's labour-force and household-income instrument. Its own scope statement, quoted directly: "Visa acompanhar as flutuações trimestrais e a evolução, no curto, médio e longo prazos, da força de trabalho, e outras informações necessárias para o estudo do desenvolvimento socioeconômico do País. Para atender a tais objetivos, a pesquisa foi planejada para produzir indicadores trimestrais sobre a força de trabalho e indicadores anuais sobre temas suplementares permanentes ... Tem como unidade de investigação o domicílio." Its annual income release is titled and catalogued: IBGE's own library record reads "Título: Rendimento de todas as fontes : 2023 / IBGE, Coordenação de Pesquisas por Amostra de Domicílios ... Outro título: Pesquisa nacional por amostra de domicílios contínua", and that release's PDF (liv102079_informativo.pdf, 2.4MB, extracted cleanly) carries a dedicated section headed "Rendimento domiciliar per capita". THIS NODE CARRIES NO OUTGOING OR INCOMING EDGE, DELIBERATELY. It was researched because br-ipca-fpe.json hypothesised it as the source behind the "renda domiciliar per capita (rdpc)" column in TCU's FPE Decisão Normativa. That hypothesis was tested three ways this round and failed all three — TCU's DN names only the agency, LC 62/1989 names not even the agency, and the numbers do not match (PNADC's published 2023 headline is "...ainda maior (11,5%), alcançando o valor de R$ 1 848...", against TCU's rdpcn of R$ 1.892,75) — so the node stands on its own merits and the edge is recorded as rejected in _dropped rather than minted. The product page was fetched via the r.jina.ai rendering proxy (TIER B) after www.ibge.gov.br returned a genuine 403 with a WAF body on this path twice; the library catalogue record and the release PDF were fetched with plain curl at TIER A.
reports.cadence_note: Four cadences in one survey, quoted verbatim from IBGE's own "O que é" block: "Periodicidade de divulgação das informações: Mensal - Conjunto restrito de indicadores relacionados à força de trabalho e somente para o nível geográfico de Brasil; Trimestral - Conjunto de indicadores relacionados à força de trabalho para todos os níveis de divulgação da pesquisa; Anual - Demais temas permanentes da pesquisa e indicadores complementares à força de trabalho; e Variável - Outros temas ou tópicos dos temas permanentes a serem pesquisados com maior periodicidade ou ocasionalmente." releases_per_year is set to the fastest stated tier (12, the monthly restricted-indicator release) because that is the rate at which a document actually appears; the quarterly labour-force release and the annual supplements — including "Rendimento de todas as fontes", the one relevant to the rejected rdpc lead — are slower tiers of the same survey and are not separate nodes in this file.

reports.title: Finanças do Brasil — Dados Contábeis dos Municípios (FINBRA), via SICONFI
reports.publisher: Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional (STN), Ministério da Fazenda
reports.description: The national consolidation of every Brazilian federative entity's accounting and fiscal declarations, collected through SICONFI (Sistema de Informações Contábeis e Fiscais do Setor Público Brasileiro) and published by the Tesouro Nacional. STN's own Cartilha defines it and names its statutory origin in one sentence, quoted directly: "O Finbra é o nome do banco de dados formado pelas informações das declarações recebidas pelo Tesouro Nacional por determinação da Lei Complementar 101/2000, a Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal – LRF. Tal banco de dados contém um conjunto de informações contábeis e fiscais enviadas pelos entes da Federação sobre a sua execução orçamentária e financeira." Its history and the tense shift, both quoted directly: "O Finbra nasceu como uma série de volumes publicados anualmente pelo Tesouro Nacional, intitulada 'Finanças do Brasil – Dados Contábeis dos Municípios'. Cada volume continha os dados consolidados da execução orçamentária de quase 5.500 municípios brasileiros, referentes ao exercício financeiro anterior" — note "nasceu como", past tense: the printed annual volume series is historical. The live form is stated in the same document: "Em 2014, com a criação do Siconfi ... o novo Finbra passou a ser disponibilizado em formato CSV, atualizado de maneira automática e online, sem a necessidade de processamentos adicionais. É uma consulta pública e que fica disponível para qualquer usuário que tenha acesso à internet." What it now contains is stated twice: "Com o aumento da quantidade de relatórios recebidos no Siconfi em 2015, o Finbra foi consequentemente aprimorado para trazer, além de todos os dados da Contas Anuais, também os dados do Relatório Resumido de Execução Orçamentária – RREO e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal – RGF", and "A tela mostrará três opções de consultas de acordo com os relatórios recebidos: Contas Anuais, RGF e RREO." This makes FINBRA the aggregation point for br-rreo and br-rgf (br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json), which until this round had no downstream at all. The Cartilha PDF was fetched with plain curl at TIER A (HTTP 200, 952,735 bytes, a genuine text PDF extracted with pdftotext -layout); the STN product page and the SICONFI consultation page were both independently confirmed reachable at TIER A. The gov.br/tesouronacional contabilidade-e-custos/siconfi page suggested as an alternative route returns a genuine HTTP 401 ("Conteúdo Restrito É necessário autenticar para visualizar essa página") and is not used.
reports.cadence_note: Two cadences, and the document is explicit about which is which. The original series was annual — "uma série de volumes publicados anualmente pelo Tesouro Nacional", one volume per exercício financeiro — but STN's own text puts that in the past tense ("nasceu como"). Since 2014 the live product is a continuously-updated public CSV consultation ("atualizado de maneira automática e online"), which has no discrete release event to count. releases_per_year is kept at 1 because the underlying declarations remain organised by exercício and the Contas Anuais consultation is annual by construction; it should be read as the reporting cycle, not as a publication event, and the continuous form means the true figure is either much higher or undefined.

reports.title: Manual de Demonstrativos Fiscais (MDF)
reports.publisher: Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional (STN), Ministério da Fazenda
reports.description: STN's standing methodological manual for the LRF's fiscal demonstratives — the direct sibling of br-mcasp (Manual de Contabilidade Aplicada ao Setor Público, br-fpm-population.json), covering the fiscal reports where MCASP covers the accounting standards. Its scope is defined verbatim in STN's own FINBRA Cartilha: "O RREO deve ser elaborado seguindo as regras contidas no Manual de Demonstrativos Fiscais – MDF. O MDF estabelece regras de harmonização a serem observadas, de forma permanente, pela Administração Pública para a elaboração do Anexo de Riscos Fiscais (ARF), do Anexo de Metas Fiscais (AMF), do Relatório Resumido da Execução Orçamentária (RREO) e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal (RGF), e define orientações metodológicas, consoante os parâmetros definidos pela LRF." That single sentence names all four instruments it governs, two of which are already nodes (br-rreo, br-rgf), and states its own subordination to the LRF (br-lc-101-2000). Its reissue rule, also verbatim: "O MDF é constantemente atualizado, e a observância da edição vigente deve ser dada seguindo o exercício financeiro..." HONEST LIMITATION ON THIS NODE, stated rather than glossed: the MDF's own document and its own STN landing page were NOT fetched this round. Every quotation above is STN's description of the MDF inside the FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha (TIER A, plain curl, genuine text PDF) — an authoritative first-party source for what the MDF is and what it governs, written by the same Secretaria that publishes it, but not the manual's own text. The `url` below therefore points at that Cartilha rather than at an unverified MDF URL. A future round should re-source this node from a specific numbered edition of the MDF itself, which would also give the node a real edition history in the shape br-mcasp already has.
reports.cadence_note: Inferred, not stated. STN says only "O MDF é constantemente atualizado, e a observância da edição vigente deve ser dada seguindo o exercício financeiro" — one binding edition per exercício financeiro, which implies an annual reissue without stating a periodicity. Same convention and the same honesty flag as br-mcasp's own cadence_note in br-fpm-population.json ("Not stated as a fixed periodicity by STN. Estimated, not stated"), except that here not even a list of dated editions was observed, so the estimate is weaker than br-mcasp's.

reports.title: Contas Nacionais Trimestrais (CNT)
reports.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
reports.description: The quarterly national accounts, and the release that carries Brazil's headline GDP figure. Its international basis is stated verbatim on IBGE's own page: "As estimativas das CNT seguem as recomendações internacionais reunidas no mais recente manual das Nações Unidas - Sistema de Contas Nacionais (SNA 2008). Todas as transações definidas no SNA para a produção (transações mercantis e não mercantis) são registradas em regime de competência, exceto as receitas do governo, que são registradas em regime de caixa." Its dependence on the annual accounts is stated equally plainly, and mechanically: "Os dados trimestrais são ajustados para os totais anuais (Sistema de Contas Nacionais Anuais - SCN), usando o procedimento estatístico de benchmarking (Denton)." That sentence is the basis for this node's edge to br-scn — the quarterly series is constrained to sum to the annual totals by a named statistical procedure, not merely cross-referenced. The page's current edition at the time of research was "Tabelas - 1º trimestre 2026". Fetched with plain curl at TIER A (HTTP 200, 151,398 bytes).
reports.cadence_note: IBGE's own metadata block states: "Tipo de operação estatística: Sistema de contas nacionais | Tipo de dados: Outro tipo de dados | Periodicidade de divulgação: Trimestral".

reports.title: Lei nº 8.213, de 24 de julho de 1991 (Planos de Benefícios da Previdência Social) — art. 41-A
reports.description: The statute governing Brazil's general social-security benefit regime (RGPS), "Dispõe sobre os Planos de Benefícios da Previdência Social e dá outras providências", used here in its consolidated (texto compilado) form. Art. 41-A, inserted by Lei nº 11.430/2006, is the provision that closes br-ipca-fpe.json's own open lead on INPC's statutory downstream use, quoted directly: "Art. 41-A. O valor dos benefícios em manutenção será reajustado, anualmente, na mesma data do reajuste do salário mínimo, pro rata, de acordo com suas respectivas datas de início ou do último reajustamento, com base no Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor - INPC, apurado pela Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística - IBGE." The statute names the index by name and names IBGE by name as its producer — the exact combination br-ipca-fpe.json searched for and did not find. Its interaction with the minimum wage is also stated, § 4º: "Para os benefícios que tenham sido majorados devido à elevação do salário mínimo, o referido aumento deverá ser compensado no momento da aplicação do disposto no caput deste artigo, de acordo com normas a serem baixadas pelo Ministério da Previdência Social." Present tense and in force. One-off foundational instrument per Research.1.md §4 — a standing statute defining a method, amended in place rather than reissued, so no releases_per_year is given; same convention as br-lc-101-2000 and br-lc-62-1989. Fetched at TIER A from planalto.gov.br (HTTP 200, 753,510 bytes) with a browser User-Agent header; the identical header-less request returns "curl: (52) Empty reply from server", which is a request-shaping requirement rather than a content workaround and is recorded rather than hidden.
reports.cadence_note: A statute, amended rather than reissued — same convention as br-lc-101-2000 (br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json) and br-lc-62-1989 (br-ipca-fpe.json). The annual cadence lives in the instrument that executes it, br-portaria-reajuste-inss, not here.

reports.title: Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF de reajuste dos benefícios do INSS (edição em vigor: nº 13, de 9 de janeiro de 2026)
reports.publisher: Ministério da Previdência Social / Ministério da Fazenda
reports.description: The annual joint ministerial instrument that actually applies the RGPS benefit readjustment art. 41-A of Lei 8.213/1991 commands. Ementa, quoted directly: "Dispõe sobre o reajuste dos benefícios pagos pelo Instituto Nacional do Seguro Social - INSS e demais valores constantes do Regulamento da Previdência Social - RPS e dos valores previstos nos incisos II a VIII do § 1º do art. 11 da Emenda Constitucional nº 103, de 12 de novembro de 2019..." Its preamble names its own legal basis chain verbatim: "OS MINISTROS DE ESTADO DA PREVIDÊNCIA SOCIAL E DA FAZENDA, no uso da atribuição que lhes confere o inciso II do parágrafo único do art. 87 da Constituição, e tendo em vista o disposto na Emenda Constitucional nº 20, de 15 de dezembro de 1998; ... no art. 41-A da Lei nº 8.213, de 24 de julho de 1991; na Lei nº 14.663, de 28 de agosto de 2023; no Decreto nº 12.797, de 23 de dezembro de 2025; e no Regulamento da Previdência Social - RPS, aprovado pelo Decreto nº 3.048, de 6 de maio de 1999, resolvem:" Art. 1º states the result: "Os benefícios pagos pelo Instituto Nacional do Seguro Social - INSS serão reajustados, a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2026, em 3,90% (três inteiros e noventa centésimos por cento)." IMPORTANT NEGATIVE, CARRIED ON THE NODE SO IT CANNOT BE QUIETLY FILLED IN LATER: the full DOU text of this Portaria contains ZERO occurrences of "INPC" and names no price index at all. It states the resulting percentage and not the index that produced it. The INPC naming is exactly one hop upstream, in art. 41-A of Lei 8.213, which this preamble cites by article number — so this file wires portaria -> br-lei-8213 -> br-inpc and deliberately does NOT draw a direct portaria -> br-inpc edge, which would overstate the evidence. Published metadata, verbatim: "Publicado em: 12/01/2026 | Edição: 7 | Seção: 1 | Página: 58". Fetched at TIER A from the Imprensa Nacional's own DOU page (HTTP 200, 104,885 bytes), located by extracting `urlTitle` from the in.gov.br search endpoint's embedded JSON. The Ministry's own PDF of the same Portaria is a scanned raster with no extractable text and was not usable; a bibliotecadigital.gestao.gov.br mirror returned a genuine 403.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, and the periodicity is an inference from the series rather than a verbatim statement inside the instrument — flagged rather than asserted. One Portaria Interministerial per year, published each January, fixing that year's readjustment percentage. The statutory basis for the annual rhythm is art. 41-A's own "será reajustado, anualmente, na mesma data do reajuste do salário mínimo", which this Portaria executes; the instrument itself states only its own effective date ("a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2026"). No release_schedule is given: only one dated instance was observed this round, which is thinner than the two-point pattern br-ipca-fpe.json required before projecting br-fpe-dn-tcu's calendar.

reports.title: Lei nº 14.663, de 28 de agosto de 2023 (política de valorização permanente do salário mínimo)
reports.description: The statute establishing Brazil's permanent minimum-wage valorisation policy, and the cleanest live INPC dependency located in this corpus. Art. 1º, quoted directly: "Esta Lei define o valor do salário mínimo a partir de 1º de maio de 2023, estabelece a política de valorização permanente do salário mínimo a vigorar a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2024, e altera os valores da tabela mensal do Imposto sobre a Renda da Pessoa Física (IRPF)..." Art. 3º caput sets the two-term formula: "Ficam estabelecidas as diretrizes para a política de valorização do salário mínimo a vigorar a partir de 2024, inclusive, a serem aplicadas em 1º de janeiro do respectivo ano, considerado que o valor decorrerá da soma do índice de medida da inflação do ano anterior, para a preservação do poder aquisitivo, com o índice correspondente ao crescimento real do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de 2 (dois) anos anteriores, para fins de aumento real, conforme apuração nos termos deste artigo." § 1º names the index and its producer: "Os reajustes para a preservação do poder aquisitivo do salário mínimo corresponderão à variação do Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC), calculado e divulgado pela Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), acumulada nos 12 (doze) meses encerrados em novembro do exercício anterior ao do reajuste." § 4º names IBGE for the GDP term as well — "a taxa de crescimento real do PIB do segundo ano anterior ao da fixação do valor do salário mínimo, apurada pelo IBGE até o último dia útil do ano e divulgada no ano anterior ao de aplicação do aumento real" — but names no titled release, which is why no GDP edge is minted from this node (see _dropped). The statute also fixes what happens when the index is late, §§ 2º–3º: "Na hipótese de não divulgação do INPC referente a um ou mais meses compreendidos no período do cálculo até o último dia útil imediatamente anterior à vigência do reajuste, o Poder Executivo federal estimará os índices dos meses não disponíveis" and "os índices estimados permanecerão válidos para os fins do disposto nesta Lei, sem qualquer revisão, e os eventuais resíduos serão compensados no reajuste subsequente, sem retroatividade" — a documented fallback rule for a missing input, which is the kind of method fidelity this corpus exists to capture. One-off foundational instrument per Research.1.md §4, so no releases_per_year. Fetched at TIER A from planalto.gov.br (HTTP 200, 36,354 bytes) with a browser User-Agent header.
reports.cadence_note: A statute defining a method, applied each 1 January by a separate annual decree (br-decreto-salario-minimo). Art. 3º fixes the application date verbatim — "a serem aplicadas em 1º de janeiro do respectivo ano" — but the statute itself is not reissued.

reports.title: Decreto anual de fixação do salário mínimo (edição em vigor: Decreto nº 12.797, de 23 de dezembro de 2025)
reports.description: The annual decree that fixes the minimum wage the following year, executing the formula Lei 14.663/2023 defines. Ementa, quoted directly: "Dispõe sobre o valor do salário mínimo a vigorar a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2026." Preamble, naming its statutory basis: "O PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA, no uso da atribuição que lhe confere o art. 84, caput, inciso IV, da Constituição, e tendo em vista o disposto na Lei nº 14.663, de 28 de agosto de 2023, e na Lei nº 15.077, de 27 de dezembro de 2024, DECRETA:" Art. 1º and its parágrafo único give the result: "A partir de 1º de janeiro de 2026, o valor do salário mínimo será de R$ 1.621,00 (mil seiscentos e vinte e um reais)" and "Em decorrência do disposto no caput, o valor diário do salário mínimo corresponderá a R$ 54,04 (cinquenta e quatro reais e quatro centavos) e o valor horário, a R$ 7,37 (sete reais e trinta e sete centavos)." The R$ 1.621,00 figure reappears verbatim inside Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF nº 13/2026 art. 2º ("não poderão ser inferiores a R$ 1.621,00 (mil seiscentos e vinte e um reais)"), independently confirming this decree's downstream use from a second document rather than from the decree's own claim about itself. Publication note, verbatim: "Este texto não substitui o publicado no DOU de 24.12.2025." Fetched at TIER A from planalto.gov.br (HTTP 200, 10,327 bytes) with a browser User-Agent header.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, and the periodicity is a series-level inference rather than a statement inside the instrument — flagged rather than asserted, same as br-portaria-reajuste-inss. One decree per year fixing the following year's minimum wage; the statutory rhythm it follows is Lei 14.663/2023 art. 3º's "a serem aplicadas em 1º de janeiro do respectivo ano". Only one dated instance (23/12/2025) was observed this round, so no release_schedule is projected.

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (planalto.gov.br, plain curl with a browser User-Agent, HTTP 200, 753,510 bytes). This is the edge br-ipca-fpe.json's own _dropped block recorded as NOT FOUND ("INPC is widely reported elsewhere as the index used to readjust INSS social-security benefits ... but no primary-source law or decree naming INPC for either purpose was located this session"), now closed from the statute's own text. Lei 8.213/1991 art. 41-A, inserted by Lei 11.430/2006: "O valor dos benefícios em manutenção será reajustado, anualmente, na mesma data do reajuste do salário mínimo, pro rata, de acordo com suas respectivas datas de início ou do último reajustamento, com base no Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor - INPC, apurado pela Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística - IBGE." `calculated_from` rather than `cites`: this is a stated indexation formula whose output — the readjusted value of every RGPS benefit in maintenance — is mechanically derived from INPC's published variation, the same shape br-ipca-fpe.json's own basis gives for br-lc-62-1989 -> br-ipca. The statute names both the index and its producing agency, which is the strongest form this corpus recognises. No reference_period is given: art. 41-A fixes the readjustment date by reference to the minimum wage's date and states no accumulation window, unlike Lei 14.663/2023 § 1º which does.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (planalto.gov.br, plain curl with a browser User-Agent, HTTP 200, 36,354 bytes). Lei 14.663/2023 art. 3º § 1º: "Os reajustes para a preservação do poder aquisitivo do salário mínimo corresponderão à variação do Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC), calculado e divulgado pela Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), acumulada nos 12 (doze) meses encerrados em novembro do exercício anterior ao do reajuste." A second, independent statutory INPC dependency alongside br-lei-8213 -> br-inpc, and the more precisely specified of the two: it names the index, names IBGE as producer, and fixes the exact accumulation window. `calculated_from` because the inflation term of the minimum wage is arithmetically the accumulated INPC variation, not a contextual reference. The statute even documents its own fallback when the input is late (§ 2º: "o Poder Executivo federal estimará os índices dos meses não disponíveis"), which presupposes a mechanical dependency rather than a discretionary one.

reference_period.stated_as: "acumulada nos 12 (doze) meses encerrados em novembro do exercício anterior ao do reajuste" — Lei 14.663/2023 art. 3º § 1º. INPC publishes monthly; this edge carries a reading once a year, over a twelve-month window closing at the end of November.

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (in.gov.br DOU text, HTTP 200, 104,885 bytes). The Portaria's preamble names the article by number: "OS MINISTROS DE ESTADO DA PREVIDÊNCIA SOCIAL E DA FAZENDA ... tendo em vista o disposto ... no art. 41-A da Lei nº 8.213, de 24 de julho de 1991..." `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites` because art. 41-A supplies the actual method the Portaria executes — which index (INPC), whose index (IBGE), on what date ("na mesma data do reajuste do salário mínimo"), and on what pro rata basis ("de acordo com suas respectivas datas de início ou do último reajustamento") — the same distinction br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json draws for br-rreo -> br-lc-101-2000 (statute supplies method) against br-fpm-population.json's br-ibge-estimativas-populacao -> br-lei-8443 (statute supplies only a mandate and a deadline). THIS EDGE IS ALSO THE ONLY ROUTE FROM THIS PORTARIA TO INPC, AND THAT IS THE POINT: the Portaria's full DOU text contains zero occurrences of "INPC" and names no index — it states only the outcome ("serão reajustados, a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2026, em 3,90%"). The index naming lives one hop upstream, here. A direct br-portaria-reajuste-inss -> br-inpc edge would assert something the document does not say and is deliberately not minted.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (in.gov.br DOU text). The Portaria's preamble names the minimum-wage valorisation statute alongside its own enabling provisions: "...tendo em vista o disposto ... no art. 41-A da Lei nº 8.213, de 24 de julho de 1991; na Lei nº 14.663, de 28 de agosto de 2023; no Decreto nº 12.797, de 23 de dezembro de 2025..." `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: Lei 14.663 defines the minimum wage's own valorisation formula, not the benefit-readjustment method — the benefit method comes from art. 41-A of Lei 8.213 (see the separate edge). What Lei 14.663 supplies to this Portaria is the legal basis for the floor value it applies, and the operative number itself arrives via the decree, not via the statute, which is why this edge is typed weaker than the other two.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY FROM BOTH ENDS, TIER A. The Portaria's preamble names the decree: "...tendo em vista o disposto ... no Decreto nº 12.797, de 23 de dezembro de 2025..." And, more strongly than a preamble citation, the decree's operative figure appears verbatim inside the Portaria's own text: Decreto 12.797/2025 art. 1º sets "o valor do salário mínimo será de R$ 1.621,00 (mil seiscentos e vinte e um reais)", and Portaria art. 2º applies that same number as the benefit floor — "não poderão ser inferiores a R$ 1.621,00 (mil seiscentos e vinte e um reais)". `uses_data_from`: the decree's published figure is a literal input carried into the Portaria's own provisions, confirmed by two independently fetched documents agreeing on the value rather than by either document's claim about itself.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (planalto.gov.br, plain curl with a browser User-Agent, HTTP 200, 10,327 bytes). Decreto 12.797/2025's preamble: "O PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA, no uso da atribuição que lhe confere o art. 84, caput, inciso IV, da Constituição, e tendo em vista o disposto na Lei nº 14.663, de 28 de agosto de 2023, e na Lei nº 15.077, de 27 de dezembro de 2024, DECRETA:" `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`, and the contrast with br-ipca-fpe.json's br-resolucao-cmn-5141 -> br-decreto-12079-2024 is exactly the reason: that edge was typed `cites` because the decree "delegates the choice and fixes no method of its own". Lei 14.663 is the opposite case — art. 3º states the whole computation the decree's single number is the output of ("o valor decorrerá da soma do índice de medida da inflação do ano anterior ... com o índice correspondente ao crescimento real do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de 2 (dois) anos anteriores"), including the index, the accumulation window and the fallback rules. The decree publishes the result; the statute supplies the method.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (STN's own FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha PDF from siconfi.tesouro.gov.br, plain curl, HTTP 200, 952,735 bytes, genuine text PDF extracted with pdftotext -layout). The Cartilha states the database's statutory origin in its own words: "O Finbra é o nome do banco de dados formado pelas informações das declarações recebidas pelo Tesouro Nacional por determinação da Lei Complementar 101/2000, a Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal – LRF." Independently corroborated at TIER A from the statute itself (planalto.gov.br, HTTP 200, 254,717 bytes): art. 48 § 2º (incluído pela LC 156/2016) requires that "A União, os Estados, o Distrito Federal e os Municípios disponibilizarão suas informações e dados contábeis, orçamentários e fiscais conforme periodicidade, formato e sistema estabelecidos pelo órgão central de contabilidade da União, os quais deverão ser divulgados em meio eletrônico de amplo acesso público" — the provision under which SICONFI is the system — and art. 51 caput obliges the consolidation itself: "O Poder Executivo da União promoverá, até o dia trinta de junho, a consolidação, nacional e por esfera de governo, das contas dos entes da Federação relativas ao exercício anterior, e a sua divulgação, inclusive por meio eletrônico de acesso público", with § 1º fixing the entities' own deadline ("Os Estados e os Municípios encaminharão suas contas ao Poder Executivo da União até 30 de abril"). `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`, on br-fpm-population.json's own stated test: the LRF compels the collection, names the system's owner and fixes the deadlines, but supplies no method for how the data are compiled — the method comes from the MDF and the MCASP. Same reasoning that file gives for br-ibge-estimativas-populacao -> br-lei-8443.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (STN's own FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha PDF). The Cartilha states what FINBRA ingests: "Com o aumento da quantidade de relatórios recebidos no Siconfi em 2015, o Finbra foi consequentemente aprimorado para trazer, além de todos os dados da Contas Anuais, também os dados do Relatório Resumido de Execução Orçamentária – RREO e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal – RGF." Stated a second time as an operational fact about the public consultation screen: "A tela mostrará três opções de consultas de acordo com os relatórios recebidos: Contas Anuais, RGF e RREO." `uses_data_from`: the RREO's figures, as filed by every federative entity, are literally the rows FINBRA publishes — an aggregation, not a citation. This is the first downstream edge br-rreo has had in this corpus; br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json minted only its upstream to the statute.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (STN's own FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha PDF). Same two sentences as the RREO edge, which name both reports together: "...o Finbra foi consequentemente aprimorado para trazer, além de todos os dados da Contas Anuais, também os dados do Relatório Resumido de Execução Orçamentária – RREO e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal – RGF", and "A tela mostrará três opções de consultas de acordo com os relatórios recebidos: Contas Anuais, RGF e RREO." `uses_data_from` for the same reason: the RGF filings are the source rows, aggregated nationally. Note that FINBRA also ingests a third stream, the "Contas Anuais" (DCA), which is not yet a node in this corpus — recorded as a lead in _dropped rather than minted from a single descriptive mention.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (STN's own FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha PDF). The MDF's scope sentence ends by subordinating its own methodology to the LRF's parameters: "O MDF estabelece regras de harmonização a serem observadas, de forma permanente, pela Administração Pública para a elaboração do Anexo de Riscos Fiscais (ARF), do Anexo de Metas Fiscais (AMF), do Relatório Resumido da Execução Orçamentária (RREO) e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal (RGF), e define orientações metodológicas, consoante os parâmetros definidos pela LRF." `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`: the MDF is not merely authorised by the LRF, its content is derived from it — the demonstratives it standardises are the ones LC 101/2000 arts. 52–55 require, and the limits and defined terms they test against are the statute's own. CAVEAT, STATED RATHER THAN GLOSSED: this quotation is STN's description of the MDF inside the FINBRA Cartilha, not the MDF's own text. It is a first-party source (same Secretaria, same publisher) but not the dependent document itself, which is the strict form of the project's rule. See the node description on br-mdf and the caveat entry in _dropped.

VERIFIED, TIER A SOURCE BUT NOT FROM THE DEPENDENT DOCUMENT'S OWN TEXT — the weakness is stated here rather than in a footnote. STN's FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha states the obligation directly and by name: "O RREO deve ser elaborado seguindo as regras contidas no Manual de Demonstrativos Fiscais – MDF." The MDF's own scope sentence names the RREO again from the other side: "O MDF estabelece regras de harmonização a serem observadas, de forma permanente, pela Administração Pública para a elaboração do ... Relatório Resumido da Execução Orçamentária (RREO) ... e define orientações metodológicas, consoante os parâmetros definidos pela LRF." So the relationship is asserted twice in the same first-party document, in both directions. `methodology_depends_on` is the right type — the MDF is exactly a method manual, and "o RREO deve ser elaborado seguindo as regras contidas no MDF" is a compliance obligation, not a reference. What it is NOT is a statement from an actual RREO instance about its own inputs, and the project's rule asks for the dependent document's own text. A purist should re-source this edge from a filed RREO or from the MDF itself; it is minted at MEDIUM confidence rather than dropped because the source is the Secretaria that publishes all three documents. This edge sits alongside, and does not replace, br-rreo -> br-lc-101-2000 in br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json: statute supplies the required content, manual supplies the harmonised form.

VERIFIED, TIER A SOURCE BUT NOT FROM THE DEPENDENT DOCUMENT'S OWN TEXT, AND ONE STEP WEAKER THAN THE PARALLEL RREO EDGE — both weaknesses stated rather than glossed. The citation used here is the MDF's own scope sentence, which names the RGF explicitly: "O MDF estabelece regras de harmonização a serem observadas, de forma permanente, pela Administração Pública para a elaboração do Anexo de Riscos Fiscais (ARF), do Anexo de Metas Fiscais (AMF), do Relatório Resumido da Execução Orçamentária (RREO) e do Relatório de Gestão Fiscal (RGF), e define orientações metodológicas, consoante os parâmetros definidos pela LRF." The reason this is the citation used, rather than an RGF-specific "deve ser elaborado seguindo" sentence of the kind quoted verbatim for the RREO: only the RREO version of that sentence was reproduced verbatim from the extracted Cartilha text this round. Rather than assert a parallel sentence that was not actually extracted, this edge rests on the sentence that was — which names the RGF among the four documents the MDF governs, and is sufficient on its own. MEDIUM confidence, same as the RREO edge and for the same reason (first-party but not the dependent document's own text), plus this extraction caveat.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (www.ibge.gov.br contas-nacionais path, plain curl, HTTP 200, 132,905 bytes — this path served genuine bytes where the PNAD Contínua path on the same host returned a WAF 403). IBGE's own page: "As informações da série do Sistema de Contas Nacionais - referência 2010, cabe ressaltar, são apresentadas segundo uma classificação de produtos e atividades integrada com a Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas - CNAE 2.0 e estão em conformidade com o System of national accounts 2008, SNA 2008, manual preparado sob os auspícios da Organização das Nações Unidas - ONU, da Comissão Europeia - Eurostat, do Fundo Monetário Internacional - FMI, da Organização de Cooperação e Desenvolvimento Econômico - OCDE e do Banco Mundial, o que reflete o compromisso do IBGE com a sistemática de revisões periódicas de suas práticas, conforme preconizam as recomendações internacionais." "Em conformidade com" is a methodology claim, not a citation for context, and the sentence names the manual, its edition and its five sponsoring bodies. Brazil's first edge into the international-standards.json layer, and the same shape the corpus already carries for Canadian, German and Antipodean national accounts. Note that sna-2008 is itself superseded by the 2025 SNA per its own node description, with country rollout targeting 2029-2030; IBGE's current rebasing exercise (reference year moving from 2010 to 2021) is the natural moment for that transition, but IBGE's page states only the rebasing, not an SNA edition change, so nothing is asserted about it here.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (www.ibge.gov.br contas-nacionais path, plain curl, HTTP 200, 151,398 bytes). IBGE's own page for the quarterly accounts: "As estimativas das CNT seguem as recomendações internacionais reunidas no mais recente manual das Nações Unidas - Sistema de Contas Nacionais (SNA 2008). Todas as transações definidas no SNA para a produção (transações mercantis e não mercantis) são registradas em regime de competência, exceto as receitas do governo, que são registradas em regime de caixa." The second sentence is what makes this `methodology_depends_on` beyond doubt: it does not merely claim conformity, it applies a specific SNA recording rule (accrual for production, cash for government receipts) and states its own exception to it. An independent statement from the quarterly programme rather than an inheritance from the annual one, so it is minted as its own edge rather than assumed through br-cnt -> br-scn.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A (www.ibge.gov.br contas-nacionais path). IBGE's own page for the quarterly accounts states the constraint and names the technique: "Os dados trimestrais são ajustados para os totais anuais (Sistema de Contas Nacionais Anuais - SCN), usando o procedimento estatístico de benchmarking (Denton)." `uses_data_from` rather than `calculated_from`, and the distinction is worth stating because Denton benchmarking is mechanical: the quarterly series' own content comes from indicator surveys and is not derived from the annual accounts, but it is then constrained to reconcile to the annual totals, so SCN's published figures are a direct input to what CNT finally publishes without being the thing it is computed from. Rating it `calculated_from` would overstate the direction of derivation; rating it `cites` would understate a named, binding statistical procedure.

_dropped.edge: br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-pnad-continua (PNAD Contínua as the source of TCU's 'renda domiciliar per capita (rdpc)' column in the FPE Decisão Normativa)
_dropped.why: REJECTED, AND THE REJECTION IS ONE OF THIS ROUND'S MOST VALUABLE FINDINGS. br-ipca-fpe.json's strongest open lead was that PNAD Contínua supplies the rdpc figures TCU uses to compute the FPE coefficients. It was tested at three independent levels of the chain and failed at all three, and a fourth, numeric test failed as well. (1) THE TCU SIDE. TCU's DN 209/2024 (FPE-2025) was re-read in full. Its Anexo column notes source the population column to a statutory hook — "Coluna B: população da UF fornecida pela Fundação Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) com data de referência em 31/7/2022 e malha territorial de 30/4/2023 (art. 102, inciso I, da Lei 8.443, de 16/7/1992)" — but source the income column to the agency and nothing else: "Coluna F: renda domiciliar per capita (rdpc) da UF fornecida pelo IBGE, relativa ao exercício de 2023." The table header says the same: "Renda domiciliar per capita (rdpc) (fonte: IBGE, ref. 2023)". PNAD CONTÍNUA IS NOT NAMED ANYWHERE IN THE DN — no survey name, no titled release, no statutory hook. (2) THE STATUTE SIDE, checked as an alternative route. LC 62/1989 art. 2º § 3º (redação da LC 143/2013) does not even name IBGE: "Para efeito do disposto neste artigo, serão considerados os valores censitários ou as estimativas mais recentes da população e da renda domiciliar per capita publicados pela entidade federal competente." The contrast inside the same statute is instructive — art. 3º does name the agency ("...com base no resultado do Censo de 1991, realizado pela Fundação IBGE") — so the generic wording in § 3º is a drafting choice, not an oversight. (3) THE IBGE SIDE. PNAD Contínua is solidly documented as a release and is minted as a node on its own merits, but nothing on IBGE's side claims TCU as a consumer. (4) THE NUMERIC CORROBORATION TEST, run because no document connects the two, AND IT CAME BACK NEGATIVE. TCU's own Anexo gives the national figure it used: "Na observação, apresenta-se o valor da rdpcn, também fornecido pelo IBGE (R$ 1.892,75), a partir do qual se calcula o valor de referência (72% da rdpcn = R$ 1.362,78)". PNADC's published 2023 headline, from the "Rendimento de todas as fontes: 2023" release itself: "...ainda maior (11,5%), alcançando o valor de R$ 1 848, o maior da...". R$ 1 848 ≠ R$ 1.892,75. The published series is real (deflated); TCU's appears to be nominal or otherwise differently based. A query to IBGE's own SIDRA/servicodados aggregate metadata API (api/v3/agregados?pesquisa=PD, HTTP 200) found NO PNADC aggregate publishing a national mean renda domiciliar per capita at all — the PNADC tables expose rdpc only as classes/faixas, never as a national mean level. CONCLUSION, STATED PLAINLY SO IT IS NOT QUIETLY RE-OPENED: the most likely real-world mechanism is a direct, unpublished data supply from IBGE to TCU, which would mean there is no document node behind that column at all and br-ipca-fpe.json's 'gap' is a genuine structural feature of the Brazilian FPE process rather than a research failure. If a future round confirms that, the right modelling is a terminus (TerminalReason 'unpublishable') on the TCU side, not an edge to PNADC. Verification: TCU at TIER B (portal.tcu.gov.br returned HTTP 200 and ~50KB that were a JS bot-challenge page, not the PDF — confirmed by inspecting the bytes: `<!DOCTYPE html> ... window["bobcmn"]`), LC 62/1989 and the PNADC release PDF at TIER A.

_dropped.edge: Resolução CMN nº 2.615, de 30 de junho de 1999 -> br-ipca (the resolution that first named IPCA as Brazil's inflation-target index)
_dropped.why: FOUND, VERIFIED, AND DELIBERATELY NOT MINTED — this resolves br-ipca-fpe.json's own open question about the number while producing a negative on the node. Resolução CMN 2.615/1999 was fetched at TIER A from the Banco Central's own normativo repository (bcb.gov.br/pre/normativos/res/1999/pdf/res_2615_v2_L.pdf, HTTP 200, 18,544 bytes, genuine text PDF). THE NUMBER br-ipca-fpe.json DECLINED TO ASSERT IS CORRECT. Ementa: "Fixa as metas para a inflação e seus respectivos intervalos de tolerância, bem como o índice de preços a que se aplicam, para os anos 2001, 2000 e 1999." Art. 1º, verbatim, is exactly the provision that was being looked for: "Determinar que o índice de preços relacionado às metas para a inflação, referido no art. 1º, parágrafo 1º, do Decreto nº 3.088, de 21 de junho de 1999, é o Índice de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo (IPCA), calculado pelo Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)." Its preamble names the parent decree: "...tendo em vista o disposto no Decreto nº 3.088, de 21 de junho de 1999, RESOLVEU". Signed "Brasília, 30 de junho de 1999 / Arminio Fraga Neto / Presidente". WHY IT IS STILL NOT A NODE: it is revoked, and the revocation was independently verified rather than taken from the face of the document alone. The BCB PDF carries the flag "Documento normativo revogado pela Resolução nº 4.367, de 11/9/2014", and Res. 4.367/2014 was fetched separately (TIER A, HTTP 200, 19,020 bytes); its Art. 1º lists the revoked instruments verbatim and 2.615 is among them: "Ficam revogadas as Resoluções ns. 38, de 15 de outubro de 1966; ... 2.615, de 30 de junho de 1999; 2.776, de 3 de outubro de 2000; ...", under the ementa "Revoga resoluções sem função por decurso de prazo ou por regulamentação superveniente". Its parent, Decreto 3.088/1999, is also revoked (effective 1 January 2025 — see br-decreto-12079-2024 in br-ipca-fpe.json). This project does not mint discontinued or superseded instruments as live nodes, so no br-resolucao-cmn-2615 node and no historical IPCA edge is created; the live equivalent, br-resolucao-cmn-5141, is already in the corpus and already carries that edge. Recorded in full here because the finding is genuinely useful in both directions: it confirms the historical claim (IPCA has been the target index by CMN resolution continuously since 30 June 1999) and it closes the lead permanently, so no future round re-opens it expecting a live node.

_dropped.edge: br-lc-62-1989 -> a national GDP release (the '75% da variação real do Produto Interno Bruto nacional' term in the FPE floor)
_dropped.why: WEAK, FLAGGED BY THE RESEARCH AND NOT MINTED. LC 62/1989 art. 2º, inciso II (redação da LC 143/2013) states the term verbatim, at TIER A from planalto.gov.br: "a partir de 1º de janeiro de 2016, cada entidade beneficiária receberá valor igual ao que foi distribuído no correspondente decêndio do exercício de 2015, corrigido pela variação acumulada do Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo (IPCA) ou outro que vier a substituí-lo e pelo percentual equivalente a 75% (setenta e cinco por cento) da variação real do Produto Interno Bruto nacional do ano anterior ao ano considerado para base de cálculo." The IPCA half of that sentence is already minted (br-lc-62-1989 -> br-ipca, br-ipca-fpe.json). The GDP half is not, and the reason is precise: the statute names the CONCEPT "Produto Interno Bruto nacional" and names neither an agency nor a titled release. This is structurally the same gap as the rdpc column in TCU's FPE Decisão Normativa — an indicator reference, not a document-to-document dependency. It is deliberately not upgraded on the reasoning that 'everyone knows IBGE produces the PIB', which is exactly the inference the evidence standard exists to exclude. Note also that even granting the agency, the corpus now holds two candidate targets, br-scn (annual) and br-cnt (quarterly, which is where the headline annual growth rate actually lands), and nothing in the statute chooses between them. A future round could close this from the implementing side — TCU's own DN or an STN/Tesouro instrument may name the release it reads the GDP variation from, and that would be the document to look for, not another reading of LC 62.

_dropped.edge: br-lei-14663 -> a titled IBGE GDP release (the 'taxa de crescimento real do PIB ... apurada pelo IBGE' term in the minimum-wage formula)
_dropped.why: MEDIUM, AND STILL NOT MINTED — recorded separately from the LC 62 GDP entry above because the evidence is strictly stronger and the distinction is the finding. Lei 14.663/2023 art. 3º § 4º, TIER A from planalto.gov.br: "Para fins de aumento real, será aplicado, a partir de 2024, o percentual equivalente à taxa de crescimento real do PIB do segundo ano anterior ao da fixação do valor do salário mínimo, apurada pelo IBGE até o último dia útil do ano e divulgada no ano anterior ao de aplicação do aumento real." Unlike LC 62/1989, THIS STATUTE DOES NAME IBGE, and it fixes the reference period and the publication deadline. What it still does not name is a titled release. The blocker is therefore not 'which agency' but 'which of that agency's two national-accounts products': br-scn (Sistema de Contas Nacionais, anual) and br-cnt (Contas Nacionais Trimestrais) are both now nodes in this file, both publish real GDP growth, and the annual rate for a calendar year is in practice carried by the quarterly programme's fourth-quarter release while being consolidated by the annual one. Nothing in § 4º chooses between them, and picking one would be inventing the half of the citation the statute omitted. The corpus does hold a precedent for minting an agency-level edge — br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-ibge-estimativas-populacao (br-ipca-fpe.json), where the DN also named only "fornecida pela ... IBGE" — but that case had exactly one plausible target and this one has two, which is the difference. A future round should look for the Executive's own calculation memo or the Decreto's exposição de motivos, which would name the release actually read.

_dropped.edge: br-scn -> br-pia-empresa / br-paic / br-pac / br-pas (the four IBGE annual surveys the national accounts name as their own inputs)
_dropped.why: A GENUINE LEAD, blocked only by the targets not existing. IBGE's own SCN page names its domestic inputs verbatim, at TIER A: "O Sistema de Contas Nacionais Anuais - SCN, como sistema síntese, reúne informações de várias pesquisas do IBGE tais como a Pesquisa Industrial Anual - Empresa - PIA-Empresa, a Pesquisa Anual da Indústria da Construção - PAIC, a Pesquisa Anual de Comércio - PAC e a Pesquisa Anual de Serviços - PAS. Reúne ainda informações econômicas de registros fiscais e administrativos como a Escrituração Contábil Fiscal - ECF e dados de agências reguladoras." This is the strongest form of evidence the project recognises — the dependent document naming its own inputs by title, in its own words — and four edges are available the moment the four survey nodes are researched. Each is a titled, recurrent IBGE annual release, so each qualifies as a node under the ordinary rule; none was researched this round because the round's budget went to the FINBRA and national-accounts clusters. The same sentence also names the Escrituração Contábil Fiscal (ECF), a Receita Federal tax-return record rather than a publication, which on the corpus's own rules is a terminus candidate (TerminalReason 'unpublishable') rather than a report — the same shape as the CRA PD7 accounts behind SEPH. Worth doing together, since the four surveys plus the ECF terminus would give br-scn a complete documented input set, which almost no node in this corpus has.

_dropped.edge: br-finbra -> the SICONFI 'Contas Anuais' / Declaração de Contas Anuais (DCA)
_dropped.why: A LEAD, and the third of FINBRA's three input streams. STN's Cartilha names all three together — "A tela mostrará três opções de consultas de acordo com os relatórios recebidos: Contas Anuais, RGF e RREO" — and two of the three are now minted as edges (br-finbra -> br-rreo, br-finbra -> br-rgf) because br-rreo and br-rgf already existed as nodes from br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json. The Contas Anuais / DCA has no node, and none was created from a single descriptive mention: the Cartilha names it as a consultation option, not as a titled recurring release with a publisher, cadence and URL of its own. It is a real annual filing obligation under LC 101/2000 art. 51 ("Os Estados e os Municípios encaminharão suas contas ao Poder Executivo da União até 30 de abril"), so the node is almost certainly buildable from a Tesouro Nacional instrument or the MDF itself — a tractable target for a future Brazilian fiscal round, alongside re-sourcing br-mdf from its own text.

_dropped.edge: br-rgf -> br-mdf (methodology citation sourced from STN's Cartilha rather than from the RGF's own text)
_dropped.why: AN ANNOTATION ON A MINTED EDGE, not a rejection. Both MDF edges in this file (br-rreo -> br-mdf and br-rgf -> br-mdf) rest on STN's FINBRA/SICONFI Cartilha describing the RREO and the RGF, not on an actual RREO or RGF instance stating its own methodological source. The project's rule asks for the dependent document's own text, and this is one step short of that. Two reasons they are minted anyway rather than dropped: the source is the Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional, which publishes all three documents, so it is first-party for every end of the relationship; and the relationship is asserted from both directions inside it ("O RREO deve ser elaborado seguindo as regras contidas no Manual de Demonstrativos Fiscais – MDF" from the report's side, and the MDF's own scope sentence naming the RREO and the RGF among the four demonstratives it governs). The RGF edge is the weaker of the two by one further step: only the RREO-specific "deve ser elaborado seguindo" sentence was reproduced verbatim from the extracted Cartilha text this round, so the RGF edge rests solely on the MDF scope sentence. Both should be re-sourced from a filed RGF/RREO or from the MDF's own front matter when br-mdf is re-researched from its own document.

HYPOTHESIS APPEARS FALSE, not merely unverified — which is a stronger and more useful answer than the one br-ipca-fpe.json's own _dropped entry recorded. That entry paired two hypothesised INPC uses, INSS benefit readjustment and FGTS correction. The INSS half is now closed with a real edge (br-lei-8213 -> br-inpc, minted in this file, and the round-1 entry rewritten as resolved). The FGTS half is not, and the reason is that FGTS accounts are remunerated by TR plus 3% a.a. under Lei 8.036/1990, not by any consumer price index — so there is probably no instrument to find. Stated at the confidence it deserves: no primary text of Lei 8.036/1990 was fetched this round to quote that provision verbatim, so this is recorded as 'the hypothesis looks incorrect rather than merely unsourced', not as a verified negative. A future round wanting to close it properly should read Lei 8.036/1990 art. 13 directly rather than searching for an INPC instrument that the mechanism suggests does not exist.
